ai.title: AI agents and AI features that run inside real businesses
ai.intro: We put AI where work actually happens — in your app, your tools and your WhatsApp — with permissions, audit trails and humans in the loop where it matters.

items.title: Operations agents
items.text: Agents that follow up on overdue work, chase approvals and escalate to the right person — the same pattern that runs KitchenEye's checklist alerts.

items.title: Answers from your documents
items.text: Search and Q&A over your company's docs, tickets and policies, with sources shown for every answer and access limited to what each person may see.

items.title: Customer-facing assistants
items.text: Ordering, booking and support assistants on WhatsApp, web and in-app that hand over to a person when they should.

cases.title: Products we've designed, built and run

items.title: Indovyapar
items.problem: Shoppers and sellers needed one marketplace — catalogue, single checkout across vendors, and vendor onboarding with KYC and payouts.
items.result: Result: [add a number — e.g. vendors onboarded, orders per month, launch time]

items.title: KitchenEye
items.problem: Owners of multi-outlet kitchens couldn't see whether daily checklists were actually done before service.
items.result: Result: [add a number — e.g. outlets live, checklist completion rate]

items.title: Pakka Kaam
items.problem: Builders, material vendors and site workers ran on calls and paper — orders, attendance and wages had no single record.
items.result: Result: [add a number — e.g. sites live, workers paid weekly]

process.title: Discover
process.text: A short call and a written scope: users, workflows, what success looks like and where AI genuinely helps.

process.title: Prototype
process.text: A clickable prototype or working slice in about two weeks, so you can test it with real users early.

process.title: Build & launch
process.text: Weekly releases you can try, with web, mobile and backend built by one team and shipped to production.

process.title: Run & improve
process.text: We stay on after launch — monitoring, support and the next features, with the same engineers.
